analysis:
The NCTC was designed after the 2008 Mumbai attacks as a single point of control and coordination for counter-terrorism, with powers to search and arrest. It was meant to be commissioned on 1 March 2012.

A group of chief ministers, including Mamata Banerjee, Narendra Modi, Naveen Patnaik and Jayalalithaa, opposed the agency as an infringement of federalism. NDTV reported that the launch was not operationalised after that opposition. At a chief ministers' meeting on 5 May 2012, Chidambaram was still seeking support to establish the NCTC.

The agency never became operational in the UPA period, and the proposal was later described as discarded. The 1 March 2012 target was therefore missed.
notes: The 1 March 2012 commissioning date is from NDTV. The NCTC order's exact notification date (reported as 3 February 2012) was not independently confirmed, so the claim date is set to the intended commissioning date. The quote is the text of paragraph 6.1 of the order as read out by Chidambaram on 5 May 2012. [ingest: 1 evidence link(s) blocked/unreachable to the checker; verify manually]
